data.exact_reserve_text: There have been positive reserve movements in the year, particularly on the 2016 and prior years of account, which has mainly arisen from an improvement in reserves on the Property account.

Significant catastrophe losses in 2017 which materially impacted the Syndicate (notably Hurricane Harvey, Irma and Maria) and affected middle years of account.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a significant favourable movement in prior year reserves in 2018: gross claims outstanding decreased by GBP 132.187m (a c.49% release versus the opening gross reserves at 1 Jan 2018). Management attributes the positive movement primarily to favourable claims development, notably improvements in reserves on the Property account, and was supported by reinsurance recoveries. Despite material 2017/2018 catastrophe activity (e.g. Hurricanes Florence, Michael, Hawaiian lava flows and California wildfires) which affected current-year results, prior years (notably the 2016 year) showed reserve releases at the gross level.
raw_causal_phrases: There have been positive reserve movements in the year, particularly on the 2016 and prior years of account, which has mainly arisen from an improvement in reserves on the Property account.
In 2018 there has been an improvement of GBP 12.6m on closed year reserves, which makes up the largest proportion of the result.

Favourable movements of GBP 13.8 million, (2017: GBP 14.4 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding and IBNR, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior-year movement taken directly from the Balance Sheet and Technical Provisions reconciliation (note 17) respectively (both presented in the accounts in GBP 000). Prior year development used is the GROSS change in prior year provisions (Insurance liabilities column) = (132,187) i.e. a gross release of GBP 132.187m. Net movement (after reinsurance) equals -72.414m. Claims development triangle is available (gross) and included; triangle values are presented in the source as thousands. No explicit LOB-level split of the gross prior-year movement provided; Property cited in narrative as main contributor.
